notes: SKYLINE HEIST launch: the Skyline Loot (LOOT) launch token and one application contract, Game (src/Game.sol), the pepe2pepe ArcadeRewardVault with the launch policy folded in. Game constructor (address creator, address launchToken, address verifier, bytes32 rules): creator is $owner, the launch owner, who alone can recover unused tokens and only after closesAt; launchToken is $token, the deployed LaunchToken paid as rewards; verifier is the unfunded reward-voucher signer named by the approved workflow context, with no other power; rules is the rulesHash of the approved arcade engine from the same context. Fixed in source: 1 LOOT per verified point, at most 100 points per run, closesAt = deployment time + 365 days (read closesAt() after deployment). The constructor makes no external calls. The vault holds nothing at launch; the owner funds it after launch by a plain LOOT transfer. Entry is free and players pay only gas to claim. The pool pairs with IMD at the launch policy fee; supply and allocations are handled by the factory and are not manifest fields.
